title: Modeling the zinc effect on OsASR5-STAR1 promoter interaction by molecular dynamics.
authors: Barros, Nicolle Louise Ferreira; Siqueira, Andrei Santos; Arenhart, Rafael Augusto; Margis-Pinheiro, Marcia
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子动力学模拟研究锌离子对植物转录因子OsASR5与STAR1启动子DNA结合的影响，聚焦TF-DNA互作机制与构象动态，高度契合本课题。
abstract: Intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs) have numerous dynamic conformations. Given the difficulties in tracking temporarily folded states of this kind of protein, methods such as molecular modeling and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations make the process less costly, less laborious, and more detailed. Few plant IDPs have been characterized so far, such as proteins from the Abscisic acid, Stress and Ripening (ASR) family. The present work applied, for the first time, the two above-mentioned tools to test the feasibility of determining a three-dimensional transition model of OsASR5 and to investigate the relationship between OsASR5 and zinc. We found that one of OsASR5's conformers contains alpha-helices, turns, and loops and that the metal binding resulted in a predominance of alpha-helix. This stability is possibly imperative for the transcription factor activity. The promoter region of a sugar transporter was chosen to test this hypothesis and free energy calculations showed how the ion is mandatory for this complex formation. The results produced here aim to clarify which conformation the protein in the bound state assumes and which residues are involved in the process, besides developing the understanding of how the flexibility of these proteins can contribute to the response to environmental stresses.
abstract_zh: 固有无序蛋白（IDPs）具有多种动态构象。鉴于追踪此类蛋白质瞬时折叠状态的困难，分子建模和分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟等方法使该过程成本更低、劳动强度更小且更详细。迄今为止，仅有少数植物IDPs被表征，例如来自脱落酸、胁迫和成熟（ASR）家族的蛋白质。本研究首次应用上述两种工具，测试确定OsASR5三维转变模型的可行性，并探讨OsASR5与锌之间的关系。我们发现，OsASR5的一种构象体包含α-螺旋、转角和无规卷曲，且金属结合导致α-螺旋占主导地位。这种稳定性可能对转录因子活性至关重要。选择一种糖转运蛋白的启动子区域来验证这一假设，自由能计算表明，该离子对此复合物的形成是必需的。本研究结果旨在阐明蛋白质在结合状态下所采用的构象以及参与该过程的残基，同时加深理解这些蛋白质的灵活性如何有助于对环境胁迫的响应。
